No live credential values found — 'token'/'password' hits are field names, KB narrative, or a store password-gate description; email hits are explicitly synthetic test addresses (qa-explore-order-test*@example.com) already disclosed as non-personal test data.

All 5 candidate/intermediate screenshots reviewed visually (order-confirmation, portal order-details, fulfill modal, item-activity-logs, change-status dropdown, product page). No secrets, tokens, or real PII visible. Portal sidebar consistently shows 'Linh explorer / linh-explorer.myshopify.com' matching the required sub=273 account scope — no evidence of touching the forbidden 'Linh Pham' (sub=2) account.

KB-CONFLICT-001 (order JTEL87JY0 sync failure) verified UNRESOLVED and structurally identical across all 4 downstream layers: product-kb.json conflicts[], both feature-profile-builder profile_conflicts[], and both checklists' CHK-006-ORDER01-SYNC / CHK-P12-SYNC-VISIBILITY. No layer silently marks it resolved based on the user's unverified webhook-fix claim.

KB-022 ('Confirm & Send to fulfill' triggers no mutation) verified scoped strictly to the POD-disconnected state in every downstream artifact: FEAT-ORDER-PORTAL-01 profile explicitly separates the disconnected finding from the connected-branch risk/unknown, and the checklist splits it into CHK-P10 (BASELINE oracle, disconnected only) vs CHK-P16 (oracle_strength NONE, connected, NEEDS_CONFIRMATION). No generalization found.

No knowledge_kind was found improperly upgraded from OBSERVED_CURRENT/INFERRED to CONFIRMED_EXPECTED anywhere; all 'confirmed_rules' arrays in both feature profiles are empty, consistent with ZERO_DOC_BOOTSTRAP having no authority source.

Single-sample (N=1/2) limitations are consistently reflected: KB items capped confidence LOW/MEDIUM, checklist checks resting on N=1 with no authority source (KB-006, KB-009, and all NEEDS_CONFIRMATION checks) correctly carry oracle_strength NONE and status NEEDS_CONFIRMATION rather than being asserted as fact.

Coverage gaps (portal/fulfills non-existence, Bulk Fulfill unexplored, Change status transitions unexercised, POD-connected branch unknown, no DB evidence, no error paths) are documented consistently in KB coverage_gaps, both feature profiles' unknown_areas/risks, and both checklists' checks_needing_confirmation / excluded_dimensions.

gate_results.note: All checks in both checklists carry oracle.kb_ids/oracle_strength and an applicability block (role/state/environment).
